notes: The changelog list in #content is a series of h2 links '<version> Changelog' each followed by a 'Released on ...' paragraph. Excluded 1.14.0-beta.2, 1.14.0-beta.1, 1.13.0-rc.3, 1.13.0-rc.2, 1.12.0-rc.2, 1.12.0-rc.1, 1.12.0-beta.1 (pre-releases), everything from 1.11.4 down to 1.5 (older than 1.12.0), the 'Released on' dates, the sidebar lists and site navigation.
